properties.displayName: UAV S40 - Anti-Forensics (Log Deletion / Black Box Tamper)
properties.description: 드론 anti-forensics 탐지 — UAVAuditLog_CL에서 명시적 삭제/절단/블랙박스 와이프/타임스탬프 역행 이벤트(log_delete, log_truncate, blackbox_wipe, timestamp_rewind), 또는 로그 보존 비율(RecordCountAfter/RecordCountBefore)이 UAV_Threshold_List의 MinAuditLogRetentionRatio 미만으로 급감한 경우를 탐지. MITRE: T1070
properties.query:
let minRetentionRatio = toscalar(
    _GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List')
    | where ThresholdKey == 'MinAuditLogRetentionRatio'
    | project toreal(Value));
let alertWindow = 15m;
UAVAuditLog_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| extend RetentionRatio = iff(RecordCountBefore > 0, todouble(RecordCountAfter) / todouble(RecordCountBefore), 1.0)
| where EventType in ("log_delete", "log_truncate", "blackbox_wipe", "timestamp_rewind")
    or RetentionRatio < minRetentionRatio
    or TimestampDeltaSec < 0
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    EventType == "blackbox_wipe", "안티포렌식_블랙박스_와이프",
    EventType == "timestamp_rewind" or TimestampDeltaSec < 0, "안티포렌식_타임스탬프_역행조작",
    EventType in ("log_delete", "log_truncate"), "안티포렌식_로그삭제_절단",
    "안티포렌식_로그건수_급감")
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, LogSource, EventType, RecordCountBefore, RecordCountAfter, RetentionRatio, TimestampDeltaSec, Operator, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S40 - Anti-Forensics (Log Deletion / Black Box Tamper) - {{UAVId}}
